items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I played with John Robichaux too

ctx.x: I don't know him you didn't know him at Tubby Hall yeah I don't know him

I've heard of him you know what I mean like Zutty Singleton I know Zutty personally Zutty gave me his job at the E-light on Iberdough Street in the district here after he left the Lyric Theater with John Robichaux you heard of John Robichaux I played with John Robichaux too
